name: agentshelf
description: Single-plugin marketplace by xelA31B: Agentic commerce audit: check against public standards (schema.org, policies, feeds, robots.txt, APIs) whether AI agents can find, understand and buy from your store, booking site or API, plus a ChatGPT Wallet readiness check. Reproducible score with evidence coverage and rule IDs, read-only by design, website content treated as untrusted, optional JSON output, a simulated agent shopping test and ready-to-paste fixes with scheduled re-checks.
